name: guided-view
title: Guided View
description: A manga read panel by panel, made for phones: the screen zooms from one panel to the next. It reads the panel geometry of the page model (pageGeometry: every panel's box in reading order, insets included), so a page written as PageData is drawn by Page and guided without any extra data; scans work too, with the box of each panel in percent of the page. The page is drawn once at a fixed width and a camera fits the current panel in the stage, moving in four steps (333 ms); the panels around it hide under a paper veil with wide dots that steps aside while the camera travels. A new page slides in from the side it comes from. Next and previous by tapping the page edges (on hover a paper plate with a brush arrow), the arrow keys following the reading order, Space, Page Up / Down, Home / End, a swipe (the page follows the finger, then turns or snaps back) or the toolbar. Whole page shows the page with every panel as a target (the current one framed, hover thickens a panel's line). A ReadingProgress counts the panels; a live region reads each panel's label. Optional end view (e.g. a ChapterEnd) and a slot for your buttons. Reduced motion: the camera jumps.
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/guided-view". Pass pages of the page model as { page: PageData }: their panels are found with pageGeometry, in reading order. For scans pass { src, alt, width, height, panels: [{ x, y, w, h, label? }] } with boxes in percent of the page. Give panels a label (PanelData.label): it is what a screen reader hears at each step.

meta.tagline: A manga read panel by panel: the screen zooms from one panel to the next.
meta.usage:
import { GuidedView } from "@/components/manga/guided-view"
import type { PageData } from "@/components/manga/page-geometry"

const pages: PageData[] = [/* your pages */]

<GuidedView
  pages={pages.map((page) => ({ page }))}
  direction="rtl"
  onPositionChange={({ page, panel }) => save(page, panel)}
/>

props.name: pages
props.type: ({ page: PageData; alt?: string } | { src: string; alt: string; width: number; height: number; panels: { x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number; label?: string }[] })[]
props.description: Page-model pages, or scans with their panel boxes (percent of the page).

props.name: direction
props.description: Order of taps, swipes and arrows, and of data pages that do not set reading.

props.name: toolbar
props.description: Your own buttons in the toolbar.

props.name: className
props.description: Added to the root; set its height here (default min(46rem, 86svh)).
